pick.title: Projectors found on your network
pick.description: Pick a projector or enter its address manually.

manual.title: Connect to an AWOL Aetherion projector
manual.description: The projector must be powered on: it closes its control port (TCP 4352) in standby.

data_description.host: IP address of the projector. Prefer the Ethernet address and give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.password: Only needed if network control authentication is enabled on the projector.

reauth_confirm.title: Projector password
reauth_confirm.description: The projector rejected the stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Make sure the projector is on and network control is enabled.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this address.

init.title: Power control
init.description: In standby the projector closes its control port, so the normal power-on command can't reach it. Choose how Home Assistant should power it on: your own switch, Wake-on-LAN, or both. With neither, power it on with the remote.

data.power_off_entity: Also turn this entity off after the projector is off

data_description.wake_entity: Your own power control, for example a smart plug, relay or IR blaster script. It is turned on when the projector's control port is closed.
data_description.power_off_entity: Only after the projector accepted Home Assistant's off command and is confirmed off. If it never confirms, or it comes back on, the entity is left on.
data_description.power_off_delay: Cool-down after the projector is confirmed off, before cutting power.
data_description.wol_enabled: Needs network optimized standby on the projector. It stops answering after a while in standby.
data_description.wol_mac: MAC of the projector's Wi-Fi interface. The Ethernet MAC does not wake it.
data_description.wake_host: Only needed if the projector is set up on its Ethernet IP. Give it a DHCP reservation.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address like AA:BB:CC:00:11:22.
error.mac_required: Wake-on-LAN needs the Wi-Fi MAC address.
error.power_entity_required: Choose the entity to turn off.
error.entity_cannot_turn_off: This entity can't be turned off. Use a switch, input boolean, remote or media player.

standby_port_closed.message: The projector is in standby and its control port is closed. Power it on with the remote, or set up a power-on entity or Wake-on-LAN in the integration options.

invalid_wake_entity.message: Wake entity {entity_id} must be a remote, media player, script, switch or button that does not belong to this integration.

auth_failed.message: The projector rejected the password. Re-authenticate the integration.

command_unsupported.message: This projector or firmware does not support that command.

command_out_of_range.message: The projector rejected that value as out of range.

command_unavailable.message: The projector cannot do that right now. The setting may be locked by the current picture mode, input, signal type or audio output (for example, volume when audio goes to an external device).

projector_failure.message: The projector reported an internal failure.

invalid_remote_command.message: Unknown remote command {command}. Use one of {options}, or a raw frame such as %3LASL 8.

option_read_only.message: {option} is reported by the projector but cannot be selected.

wake_no_answer.message: The projector did not answer Wake-on-LAN. It is probably in deep standby (Wi-Fi off), which happens a while after it is turned off; power it on with the remote.

send_command.name: Send protocol command
send_command.description: Sends a raw AWOL/PJLink frame, such as %3PICT ? or %3LASL 8, and returns the projector's reply.

command.name: Command
command.description: Frame starting with % and the class digit.
